A loss does not imply shutdown if revenue covers variable costs.

transcript.sourceText: The market sets a price of $15. The representative firm produces 50 units where P = MR = MC, but its ATC is $18. Loss per unit is $18 - $15 = $3, so total loss is $3 x 50 = $150. The firm may still operate because price exceeds AVC.
transcript.text: The market sets a price of 15 dollars . The representative firm produces 50 units where P equals M R equals M C , but its ATC is 18 dollars . Loss per unit is 18 dollars minus 15 dollars equals 3 dollars , so total loss is 3 dollars times 50 equals 150 dollars . The firm may still operate because price exceeds AVC.
